findings.text: The recorded-reference test was deleted and replaced, but the brief's item 4 said that if the tree differs the node must stop and report the node delta as a blocker, and the tree does differ: wall-chain-audit.log records 275 old-only nodes (272 wall, 3 wall-linked MAST interior) and non-empty new_only_edges, while the manifest records no blocker and declares complete. Repair is for the coordinator to rule on the substitution before this lands, and for the evidence fragment to state the edge-set difference explicitly rather than reporting only that no old-only node is unexplained.
